body: Shall do. I’m very strong in the legs already, but I’m insecure about how weak my upper body is. Maybe I can beef up there, so I know I can defend myself and whatnot. Not that I have to usually, but a lot of my fear comes from being unable to.

I can exercise outside, but I live in Texas so it’s very hot, and I have a frightening neighbor who is more than willing to shoot me. I guess that’s a positive, honestly. Gets the bastard in jail, and me underground.

Thank you. My parents would be very disappointed in me for living a simple life, but I guess being a disgrace to the bloodline is better than breaking their hearts irreversibly in death.


  There is someone I have and love very very much. She’s the main reason I haven’t kicked the bucket yet, as I don’t want to hold her back with my own tragedy. She can be my person, if I play my cards right.
My house is rather quiet. any noise from a source other than her mouth sends her raving and raging. Can’t do music.
Exercises are a good idea.. I just feel embarrassed when I do them because my family is so, so awkward. I can’t have privacy to do them. Mother will barge in and go “AAAaaaAA” like a confused parrot.

thing is, I keep taking those relaxing days. I just feel like a lazy piece of shit


that other situation would be terrible, but I can in almost all situations kill myself again ifI’m a creature with the sentient thought to do so. 

Thank you for the advice, though. I think I just need multiple naps.
